name: ndp
description: Work with the National Data Platform (NDP): find organizations, datasets and resources with CLIO's built-in NDP catalog tools, attach and download the selected resources, query NDP Endpoints and publish results. The work-with-ndp skill needs no MCP server; when clio-kit's ndp MCP server is available, its tools add richer catalog records to run_code scripts.

ndp.description: Optional NDP catalog records for run_code scripts: a dataset's full record with each resource's URL, format, size and description, field-level search filters, and bounded staging of a public resource URL. CLIO's built-in NDP tools work without it.
